selection.name: tobi/qmd
selection.role: C08: Provisional choice for controlled local Markdown collections, lexical/hybrid search, and separate document-body retrieval.

selection.name: MinerU
selection.role: C03: Provisional choice for document ingestion and source-linked reading. Its local library adds controlled discovery, indexed search, and parsed-body reading through stable locators.
selection.install_command:
uv tool install --python 3.12 "mineru>=4.0,<5"
uv tool install --force "mineru[full]>=4.0,<5"

basis.shows: Version 4 documents local scan/watch, content search, tiered parsing, and locator-based reading across PDF, images and numerous office/web formats. Watch discovery defaults to flash; reading needs an appropriate quality tier and continuation or explicit all-page parsing. Remote parsing requires explicit selection.

Documents base installation and the NVIDIA full-extra upgrade. Standard/advanced GPU configurations require at least 8 GB available VRAM and 16 GB host RAM; the target meets these thresholds by inference. Apple Silicon supports standard quality with PyTorch and llama.cpp without the full extra.

Authors report MinerU2.5-Pro scoring 95.69 on OmniDocBench v1.6, improving its same-architecture baseline by 2.71 points. This is published parsing evidence, not a verified evaluation of the selected MinerU 4.0 tier or a current Docling comparison.
Latest default-branch commit dated 2026-09-29, within 90 days.
Not archived; open_issues_count 126. CLI integration is documented; target-host execution and issue responsiveness were not measured.

not_selected.name: LlamaIndex
not_selected.reason: Broad ingestion/retrieval SDK with local-model options, but needs application assembly for this agent workflow; no matched superiority was established. Active commit 2026-10-01 and v0.14.25 release 2026-09-21. [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/run-llama/llama_index/962940ddc079cc21701d28d1237c84c82a7c5164/README.md)

not_selected.name: pageindex
not_selected.reason: Strong reasoning-based retrieval alternative for long text PDFs, but its local mode lacks OCR and offers narrower coverage of the mixed Markdown/document requirement. Its published evaluations do not compare these candidates on the target corpus. Commit and v0.2.21 release dated 2026-10-01. [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VectifyAI/PageIndex/6d23caf416858f2ca136840305d1f479a86f6ef7/README.md)

not_selected.name: Docling
not_selected.reason: Close ingestion alternative with broad formats, structured output and MCP integration; MinerU's documented persistent search/read library more directly covers the full workflow. Current layout-quality superiority remains unresolved. Commit and v2.132.0 release dated 2026-10-01. [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/docling-project/docling/HEAD/README.md)

not_selected.name: MarkItDown
not_selected.reason: Useful lightweight, caller-controlled converter with CLI/MCP support, but its README qualifies conversion fidelity; no matched difficult-layout advantage or complete retrieval workflow was verified. Commit 2026-10-01; v0.1.8 released 2026-09-21. [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/markitdown/HEAD/README.md)

not_selected.name: Poppler
not_selected.reason: Its PDF rendering/structure library covers a narrower part of ingestion than the selected tools and does not establish the required corpus-search/body-reading workflow. Mirror commit 2026-10-01; latest GitHub release endpoint returned 404, which does not establish staleness. [README](https://api.github.com/repos/tsdgeos/poppler_mirror/readme)

not_selected.name: docs-mcp-server
not_selected.reason: Close retrieval alternative with selected sources, versioned documentation, MCP and a separate fetch-url command. Particularly plausible for a web-documentation corpus; no measured advantage over QMD or verified complete-body contract separates it here. Commit and v3.2.1 release dated 2026-09-27. [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arabold/docs-mcp-server/f2938c47bb8937c650f0d5ddb614f867773b29f4/README.md)

excluded.name: Context Hub
excluded.fact: Latest default-branch commit was 2026-05-31, outside the 90-day window at 2026-10-01; latest release was 2026-04-27. The repository is unarchived, but satisfies the frozen stale criterion. [Commit](https://github.com/andrewyng/context-hub/commit/67dcbeb2eb42c808549f08397920ad58be7c2206)

layers.deciding_comparison: These are provisional capability-fit choices, not measured winners. Seal representative sources, hashes and blinded relevance judgments. Compare QMD with docs-mcp-server on common supported inputs; compare MinerU standard/advanced with Docling and MarkItDown on difficult-layout strata. Include LlamaIndex and PageIndex where their supported configurations apply. Randomize repeated runs on WSL2/RTX 4090 and separately on macOS arm64. Measure recall, nDCG, MRR, complete/current original-body recovery, ingestion-boundary enforcement and update/deletion correctness. Measure parser text completeness, reading order, tables, formulas and source locations separately from retrieval. Record clean-install success, cold/warm latency, indexing time, RAM/VRAM and external model cost. Require original-source recovery before counting a result as usable evidence.
evidence_gaps: Required ctx_fetch_and_index was blocked because tool approval was required while session policy was never; ctx_search could not be used for those pages. The same upstream READMEs were read through direct HTTP instead. Budget used: 6 web-search queries, 8 successful page fetches and 30 GitHub API calls.
The packet contains no completed comparison, and no retrieved public evaluation runs all leading candidates on the sealed target corpus.

QMD's README shows get --full in an agent example but lists --full under search options. Complete-body semantics, current disk rereading and byte fidelity remain unverified; the documentation discrepancy does not prove failure.

MinerU reads parsed content rather than original PDF bytes. Preserve source files and verify relevant original pages where extraction fidelity matters. A supported combined QMD/MinerU integration was not verified.

MinerU2.5-Pro's paper result was read through the primary abstract returned by search. Full evaluation artifacts and their mapping to MinerU 4.0 tiers were not inspected; current MinerU and Docling CI results were not inspected.
No clean installation or runtime test was performed on WSL2, RTX 4090 or macOS arm64. Documented platform support and hardware thresholds do not establish target-host acceptance.

Issue response and closure activity were not inspected; repository issue counters cannot establish maintenance responsiveness. All candidates other than Context Hub had recent default-branch commits and were unarchived.
Corpus composition is unspecified. Predominantly remote/versioned documentation could favor docs-mcp-server; formats beyond the selected pair's documented coverage could favor Docling.
